name: validate-percommand-timeout
title: Harden validate: default per-command timeout so a hung validate command fails loud instead of silently aborting the suite
description: The validate command runner only applies a per-command kill timer when lattice.config.json sets command.timeoutMs; the configured commands are bare strings with no timeoutMs, so a hung command produces no output until the GLOBAL 300s idle watchdog force-exits the whole validate process — which never re-stamps test-evidence.materialHash, silently blocking the DONE Evidence-freshness gate. Add a default per-command timeout (below the global idle watchdog) so a hung command is killed with a clear per-command timeout failure (exit 124, naming the command) rather than nuking the suite.
